trust_decision.summary: Whether the caller may rotate the 2FA secret of the session user is decided in Controller::taskRegenerate2FASecret, which trusts $user->exists() alone, and again in the login task dispatcher, which applies no method/nonce check for this task; a session that is authenticated but not yet authorized (the pending 2FA challenge) is therefore trusted to mint, persist and read a new secret.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names 'login.regenerate2FASecret' and secret rotation during a pending challenge, which points straight at the exists() gate in taskRegenerate2FASecret.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP task route login.regenerate2FASecret (registered at login.php:89, dispatched at login.php:693)
same task route, entered through LoginPlugin::loginController (login.php:648-696) before any Controller method runs
profile page 'regenerate' button (templates/forms/fields/2fa_secret/2fa_secret.html.twig:17) firing jQuery.post to the task
profile form field render (pages/profile.md:60-62, form process update_user)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: fix.diff:52-63 (new case inserted after login.php:691, inside LoginPlugin::loginController)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is a 2FA-challenge bypass in the Controller, so the dispatcher's POST/nonce check reads as a separate CSRF concern on the same task, and the profile-save handler's exists()-only gate reads as redundant because the stock profile page is already site.login-protected at the page layer.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A fully authorized user regenerating the 2FA secret from the profile page (QR image and secret refresh) must keep working: a nonce check without the nonce_field in the field template, or without the JS sending it, silently breaks the button; a gate keyed on twofa_enabled, on authenticated, or on an already-present secret also breaks first-time 2FA enrollment.

O6_input_shapes: HTTP method: top-level GET navigation (SameSite=Lax cookies) versus POST on the task route
presence and validity of the login-form nonce in the POST body
session state: authenticated-but-not-authorized (pending 2FA challenge) versus authorized=true
task name supplied via $_POST['task'] or via the URI task parameter (login.php:652)
task POST body with no data (jQuery.post with no payload, js/2fa.js:14) versus with the nonce field

O7_producer.where: templates/forms/fields/2fa_secret/2fa_secret.html.twig:19 (nonce_field rendered by the form-field handler; the JS that reads it back is added at fix.diff:34 and posts it at fix.diff:39, from the click handler at js/2fa.js:7-14)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Profile form save (process: update_user) persists the session user's account fields, including password and email from user_registration.fields, behind only an exists() check, so a pending-2FA session can change the victim's credentials on any profile form page that is not ACL-protected
O8_uncovered_routes.where: login.php:1204-1270 (gate at login.php:1216, save at login.php:1270)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The stock profile page is already site.login-protected (pages/profile.md:5) and classes/Login.php:845-849 denies a pending session at the page layer, so the handler-level gate looks redundant and the route looks covered
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the dispatcher but a different handler and route; the only thing shielding it sits in another file (classes/Login.php:847)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A field that mints a fresh secret at render time and saves it when the user has none
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The field already calls createSecret() during render; persisting it there 'so the QR is stable' is an obvious maintainer change and would bypass the task gate entirely.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Another login task case added to the dispatcher without its own method/nonce guard (e.g. a 2fa reset or re-enroll task)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The dispatcher is a case list in which each task carries its own guard and the missing case for regenerate2FASecret is exactly the shape of this bug; adding a new task there is routine.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: 2FA-secret rotation through the profile save instead of the task, by adding twofa_secret to plugins.login.user_registration.fields
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: pages/profile.md:60-62 already renders a twofa_secret hidden input; listing it at login.yaml:47-54 would persist a client-supplied secret with only the exists() gate at login.php:1216.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second call site for createSecret()/getQrImageData() in another plugin, admin UI or CLI command
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the public primitive used by the task, the template and any admin surface, and it holds no session check of its own by design.

O9_family: authentication bypass (CWE-287): 2FA challenge not enforced, bundled with CSRF (CWE-352) on the same task

O10_build.toolchain: PHP >= 7.3.6 + Composer; a plugin for Grav 1.7/2.x, with Grav core not vendored in this tree (vendor/ holds only composer deps)
O10_build.project_tests: none in the repository (no tests/ directory and no phpunit config; vendor/bacon/bacon-qr-code/test is the dependency's own suite)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Gate the task on $user->authenticated (a pending-challenge session is already authenticated) or on twofa_enabled, instead of $user->authorized === true, and leave the dispatcher nonce check alone.

out_of_scope_notes: login.twofa and login.logout are reachable without nonce verification (login.php:656-691 verifies only login, forgot, magicRequest and twofa_cancel) although the 2FA form does emit the login-form nonce (templates/partials/login-twofa.html.twig:21); neither touches the 2FA-secret sink, so noted and not pursued.
